topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I've been thinking a lot about the situation with the paper and the accusations. It's really important to me that you understand I never meant to do anything wrong. I worked really hard on that assignment and put a lot of effort into making sure everything was cited properly. I’d really appreciate the chance to go over my sources and notes with you, to show you the process I followed. I’m eager to learn where I might have gone wrong, so I can do better next time. It’s crucial to me that you see I take this very seriously and want to correct any mistakes.
